pin_title: 7 Halloween Face Paint & Makeup Buys Under £15 UK Parents and Partygoers Rate
pin_title_alt: 3 Easy Face Paint Kits for a Last-Minute Halloween Look
pin_hook: Skeletons, cats and sparkle - no costume shop needed
pin_description: Halloween face paint and makeup under £15: a Snazaroo black and white kit for skeleton faces, washable face paint crayons for kids, glitter gel, face gems, clown white and a bruise wheel for zombie looks. Easy Halloween makeup ideas for kids and adults in the UK. #ad #halloweenmakeup #facepaint #halloweenuk
intro: Sometimes the best Halloween costume is just a brilliant painted face. These well-reviewed face paints and makeup bits cover everything from little ones' cat whiskers to grown-up skeletons and zombies.

products.name: Snazaroo Halloween Black & White Face Paint Kit
products.headline: Everything you need for a classic skeleton face
products.why: Black and white water-based paints are the backbone of skeleton, ghost and skull looks, and Snazaroo is the brand many UK parents already trust. Washes off with soap and water.

products.name: Blue Squid Face Paint Crayons for Kids, 42 Pieces
products.headline: Mess-free face painting for little hands
products.why: Twist-up crayons are far easier than pots and brushes when you're painting a wriggly child, and this big set has plenty of colours for pumpkins, cats and monsters.

products.name: Teenitor Face & Body Glitter Gel, 12 Colours
products.headline: Instant sparkle for witches and fairies
products.why: A quick way to add shimmer to cheeks, hair or a costume without loose glitter going everywhere. Handy for both kids and adults.

products.name: Self-Adhesive Face Gems, 9 Sheets
products.headline: Glam up any Halloween look in seconds
products.why: Stick-on gems around the eyes turn a simple witch, vampire or cat look into something special, with no glue or skill needed.

products.name: Snazaroo Classic Face and Body Paint, White
products.headline: The base for ghosts, skulls and zombies
products.why: A simple pot of white is the most useful thing in any Halloween face paint stash, and it's an easy top-up if you already have colours.

products.name: UCANBE Goth White Cream to Powder Foundation
products.headline: A pale, matte base that stays put
products.why: Aimed at adults wanting a smoother vampire, clown or corpse-bride base than standard face paint gives, with a matte finish that sets.

products.name: Mysense 6 Colour Bruise Wheel SFX Makeup Kit
products.headline: Convincing zombie bruises and shadows
products.why: Purples, greens and yellows for bruises, sunken eyes and zombie skin - a cheap way to take a costume up a level.
